name: submit_strategy
description: Submit your strategic analysis and recommended stock shortlist.

brief.description: Strategic brief: market assessment, sector outlook, risk factors, how directives inform approach (~200 words)

shortlist.description: 25-35 recommended ticker symbols ordered by conviction. Pick from the provided stock universe; you may also include tickers from the user-equipped watchlist if one is provided.

topConviction.description: Why your top 5 picks stand out (2-3 sentences)

risks.description: Key risks to watch and which picks are most exposed (1-2 sentences)
